[r]One of the main reasons is that[/r] regular exercise keeps people physically healthy. [r]This is important because[/r] it helps people stay strong and active. [r]As a result,[/r] people can have a healthier lifestyle.

[r]Another important reason is that[/r] exercise can improve people's mental health. [r]In addition,[/r] it can reduce stress and make people feel happier. [r]For example,[/r] walking for 30 minutes a day can make people feel more energetic.

[r]For this reason, I would recommend[/r] doing some exercise every day. [r]People should try to[/r] walk, run or play sport, even if they only have a small amount of free time.

[r]To sum up,[/r] regular exercise [r]is an important part of modern life because[/r] it improves physical and mental health. [r]In my opinion, people should[/r] exercise regularly in order to improve their lives.
